# Living significance on held lives

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`living-significance-on-held-lives` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](living-significance-on-held-lives.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where every living claim is held, living significance is exactly self-significance everywhere with standpoint neutrality, without connection or relational neutrality; on a connected whole where each standpoint holds a living claim, self-significance with relational neutrality suffices too.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. On a valuation, a living claim is held when it lies in the own region of some standpoint; Held is every living claim being held, and Unheld is a claim no standpoint holds. (`Becoming.Valuation`, `Becoming.Valuation.Held`, `Becoming.Valuation.Unheld`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Where every living claim is held, living significance at the level of claims (every living claim significant from every standpoint) is exactly self-significance at every standpoint with standpoint neutrality, using neither connection nor relational neutrality. (`Becoming.Valuation.SelfSignificance`, `Becoming.Valuation.shares`, `Becoming.Neutral`, `Becoming.Valuation.Significant`, `Becoming.Valuation.significant_iff_held`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use; the measure counts central declaration `Becoming.Valuation.significant_iff_held` as following from its definitions (definitional or representational: S0 and N_std unpacked).
   - *On its own carrier (declared; reviewed in [RECHECK-U2.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u2-rows-on-the-root/RECHECK-U2.md)):* `Becoming.Valuation.significant_iff_held` is stated at the row's own carrier by `Becoming.ModelStatements.significant_iff_held_reading` (law 10 of this record).
   - *Place of `Becoming.Valuation.significant_iff_held`, by the rule:* own carrier (F5's verified items on its own carrier only).
3. With holding decided and every living claim reached through formed relations from a held living claim, living significance is exactly self-significance at every standpoint, standpoint neutrality, and relational neutrality into claims no standpoint holds. (`Becoming.Valuation.transmits`, `Becoming.Within`, `Becoming.Valuation.significant_iff_reached`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Holding and self-significance do not suffice: with every life held and valued by its own standpoint only, self-significance holds everywhere while standpoint neutrality, relational neutrality and living significance fail. (`Becoming.Apart.own`, `Becoming.Apart.valuation`, `Becoming.Apart.not_enough`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Holding and relational neutrality into unheld claims are needed: a life no standpoint holds has no significance under self-significance and standpoint neutrality; a life reached from a held one that no standpoint holds has no significance under self-significance and standpoint neutrality, relational neutrality into unheld claims failing. (`Becoming.Unclaimed.own`, `Becoming.Unclaimed.valuation`, `Becoming.Unclaimed.held_is_needed`, `Becoming.Relayed.related`, `Becoming.Relayed.valuation`, `Becoming.Relayed.transmission_is_needed`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. Self-significance already carries each standpoint's significance along any relation into its own region. (`Becoming.Valuation.own_transmission`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. Standpoint neutrality is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, self-significance at every standpoint with relational neutrality gives living significance without standpoint neutrality. (`Becoming.Valuation.Connected`, `Becoming.Valuation.reaches`, `Becoming.Valuation.significant_of_transmits`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
8. Read stepwise with each formation a standpoint whose own region is its own events, every living event is held, so living significance is exactly self-significance at every formation with standpoint neutrality. (`Becoming.Web.held_by_formations`, `Becoming.Web.significant_iff_self`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. With the formations as standpoints, each one's own region its closure under any relation of the unfolding and living and related the stepwise reading, sig is the only evaluative parameter supplied. The own region is the least boundary; every event is held, so living significance is self-significance with standpoint neutrality; the empty relation gives the case above, feeding the feeding closure. (`Becoming.Web.selfValuation`, `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_own_least`, `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_held`, `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_significant_iff`, `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_empty_own`, `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_feeding_own`, `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_of_unrestricted`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar; the measure counts central declaration `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_significant_iff` as following from a shared law (by reaching the grammar).
   - *Place of `Becoming.Web.selfValuation_significant_iff`, by the rule:* connected (it reaches `Becoming.«所闭之自反»` among its reasons; not declared a case of one).
10. On the claims, with regions as partial identities: where every living claim lies within some position's own region, living lies within every position's significance exactly where each position's own living lies within its significance (S0) and what is living and significant from one position lies within every other's (N_std). (`Becoming.ModelStatements.significant_iff_held_reading`, `Becoming.ModelStatements.significant_iff_reading`, `Becoming.ModelStatements.selfSignificance_iff_reading`, `Becoming.ModelStatements.shares_iff_reading`, `Becoming.ModelStatements.held_iff_reading`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
    - *On its own carrier (declared; reviewed in [RECHECK-U2.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/u2-rows-on-the-root/RECHECK-U2.md)):* `Becoming.ModelStatements.significant_iff_held_reading` states `Becoming.Valuation.significant_iff_held` at the row's own carrier. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Holding: every living claim lies in some standpoint's own region, a correspondence premise. Reading ‘anything that wants its continuation’ as holding and self-significance as wanting is an AI reading (D11).
- significant_iff_reached needs holding to be decided, the law's own condition, not a commitment of the representation, as decided equality is.
- significant_of_transmits needs connection and every standpoint holding some living claim.
- Self-significance, standpoint neutrality and relational neutrality are hypotheses, not proved premises; the result says exactly which premises living significance amounts to on held lives and proves none of them.
- Living significance is a condition, a hypothesis wherever a result uses it; on held lives this characterization is one way of stating it, and under the continuation condition, where a claim's significance is a formation's continuation, it follows (continuation-condition-yields-living-significance).
- Standpoints as formations: the laws on valuations hold for any type of standpoints, and this is the instance Pos := F; which relation a center's region is drawn along is supplied, read off the unfolding, not derived.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Proves none of self-significance, standpoint neutrality or relational neutrality, refutes no standpoint rejecting them, and infers no duty, ranking, recognition or compliance.
- Which formations want is not given here (a reading: wanting is read as self-significance).
- Self-significance ranges over living claims, so on the stepwise reading it carries the not-harm filter (Clearing.clearer_not_living), a normative reading.
- Claim-level significance does not separate counting another as a condition from counting it as a being that wants.
- Lives no standpoint holds (a dormant seed, a coma, someone who no longer wants to go on) are outside this result's theorems; they are within the range of the continuation condition, a significance that decides nothing about what anyone should do.
- Living significance is stated at the level of claims only.
- **Counterexample:** Each premise is needed: Apart (every life held and valued by its own standpoint only, neither neutrality holding: holding and self-significance do not suffice), Unclaimed (a life no standpoint holds), Relayed (a reached life no standpoint holds). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standpoints.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Standpoint neutrality is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, self-significance with relational neutrality gives living significance (Valuation.significant_of_transmits). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Standpoints.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Uses decidability of the named determinations, a logical commitment written as a hypothesis. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's proposal says “it can be anything that want's its continuation to have significance” and “if we want to add one axiom, that is for anything, its continuation into the future has significance”. The AI analysis, which Ren answered “exactly”, splits it in two halves: the dynamics fixes the extent of what a wanting formation must count, not its center; the continuation condition's one job is to put a center at every point. This result gives the formal content of the center. Formally, a center at every wanting point is self-significance, the seed at each; on held lives, what living significance adds beyond self-significance can be concentrated in standpoint neutrality: what has significance from any center has it from every standpoint, and no center is privileged. Reading self-significance as wanting and standpoint neutrality as the continuation condition is the AI's reading of the proposal, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D11). Standpoint neutrality is not the only completion: on a connected whole where every standpoint holds a living claim, relational neutrality also completes self-significance; with the relations read as dependence, relational neutrality is the valuation form of counting what one's continuation depends on, so in a whole where dependence links every two lives the derived extent with self-significance reaches every life. Standpoint neutrality is chosen because it needs no connection, not because it is the only completion. Relation to metaethical-core-characterization: that route starts from one seed and needs connection and relational neutrality; this one seeds every wanting point and, on held lives, needs only standpoint neutrality. Where the whole is connected, some claim is living and every life is held, both are equivalent to living significance; in general neither implies the other, and the earlier characterization keeps its scope. own-good-to-reachable-living-significance left a bridge from standpoint-relative to normative significance; the AI's reading names that bridge as the continuation condition. The shape of rivals persists: the principal rival accepts self-significance everywhere and keeps significance within each standpoint (Apart, where neither neutrality holds), the boundary the continuation condition denies.
